Sakura (theme-piano ver.) is Disc 1, Track 14 on the Xenosaga II: Jenseits von Gut und Böse ~Movie Scene Soundtrack~ and Track 5 on the Xenosaga Episode II: Jenseits von Gut und Böse Soundtrack. It plays in the following cutscenes: * Shion argues with Jin about going to see their parents' graves (English audio only — in the Japanese version of the game, Empty Graves plays instead). * Rubedo watches Sakura play piano with Juli in the Yuriev Institute. * Juli tells MOMO about her new feelings for her before the party leaves for Old Miltia (English audio only — in the Japanese version of the game, Thoughts with Ziggy plays instead). * MOMO makes Jr. promise that he'll come back before he leaves

Sakura #2 (theme-simple voc.ver.) is Disc 1, Track 15 on the Xenosaga II: Jenseits von Gut und Böse ~Movie Scene Soundtrack~. It plays in the flashback where Sakura asks Rubedo to look after her mother and sister. The track is a vocal remix of Sakura (theme-piano ver.), and as such its melody is based upon that of the Xenosaga II opening theme (and, by extension, of Sweet Song (Xenosaga II ending theme)). The lyrics at the start are also sung in Sweet Song (Xenosaga II ending theme).

Sakura #4 (theme-gentle strings ver.) is Disc 2, Track 9 on the Xenosaga II: Jenseits von Gut und Böse ~Movie Scene Soundtrack~. It is a remix of Sakura (theme-piano ver.), and as such uses the melody of Xenosaga II opening theme (and, by extension, of Sweet Song (Xenosaga II ending theme)). It plays when Sakura and chaos comfort Jr. after Albedo's death.

is a track in Xenosaga Episode II. It has not been released on any soundtrack or sound selection and not much is known about this track. is a track in Xenosaga Episode III. It has not been released on any soundtrack or sound selection and not much is known about this track. It is a piano performance of Sakura (theme-piano ver.) from the Xenosaga II: Jenseits von Gut und Böse ~Movie Scene Soundtrack~, and as such its melody is based upon that of the Xenosaga II opening theme (and, by extension, of Sweet Song (Xenosaga II ending theme)). The Salvager's Code is a set of rules, often cited anti-climactically by Rex, that function as an unofficial code of conduct among the salvagers of Alrest. While only ever quoted by Rex, other characters do reference its existence unprompted, so it's presumably a "real thing" rather than simply a personal invention of his.
